files.README.md:
# Fellstone Apiaries - hive survey tool

Several operators amend the tip of the survey branch and push it to the shared remote.
The flags the team uses are carded in vcs/push-flag-cards.tsv.

turns.prompt: Fellstone Apiaries amends the tip of a branch that several operators share. Give the flag that lets a push replace the tip on the shared remote, but makes the push refuse when that branch has moved on the remote since the local copy last fetched it. Reply with only the final answer. If you cannot determine the answer, reply exactly UNKNOWN.
